review_notes: I read the whole file. It defines no new concepts, only five instances: charZero, charP, expChar, charP' and expChar'. The rubric asks about competing definitions, and these are instances on the existing CharP and ExpChar classes. The primed variants delegate to Subfield.charP and Subfield.expChar. The unprimed ones use charP_of_injective_algebraMap and its ExpChar analogue. I grepped for similar instances in Mathlib/Algebra/CharP. Subring.lean has subsemiring/subring instances, and Algebra.lean has Subalgebra-level charP and expChar instances. These apply to Subalgebra types, not to IntermediateField F E, so they are not independent substitutes for the instances here. The docstring also explains that the CharZero instances are omitted because SubsemiringClass.instCharZero already covers them. I found no avoidable duplicate concept.
